name: Ian Montgomery
label: Infrastructure Engineer
summary: Infrastructure engineer with a background that spans both engineering and operations. I started in web development, spent six years running a multi-million-dollar retail operation, then came back to engineering. That time managing teams, handling competing priorities, and keeping operations running smoothly shaped how I approach building reliable platforms today. As the industry shifts toward agentic workflows, this background gives me a practical edge. I know how to break down complex problems, manage concurrent workstreams, and coordinate both people and AI agents to get things done.
